prompt:
Landscape 16:9 desktop UI mockup — first viewport of D1 Desk Chinese login page. Full-screen near-black CRT phosphor terminal aesthetic. Palette strictly: background #050805, phosphor green #33ff66, deep green #1a3d24, soft mint #9dffb0. Materials: curved glass CRT screen, visible scanline glow, bitmap monospace terminal type. No purple, no cream, no cards, no floating badges.

Composition (one surface, operable login clarity):
- Full-bleed dark glass terminal fills the entire frame like a craft CRT system.
- Top: boot/transcript lines in Chinese bitmap mono green phosphor text for product D1 Desk, e.g. system boot header acknowledging D1 Desk account workspace.
- Middle: four capability status lines listing D1、KV、Workers、邮件 as online/ready status rows — clear hierarchy, readable Chinese.
- Lower middle: password-style Token input field at a blinking cursor — label like API Token / 粘贴 API Token, field visually obvious as the primary input (masked dots or underscores), not buried in novelty.
- Permission hint in smaller phosphor text about Token permissions + a visible create Token link (创建 Token / 创建 API Token).
- Bottom action: clear CTA button or command-prompt style action reading exactly 「进入工作台」 — must be the most obvious interactive control after the token field.

Camera: straight-on landscape desktop mock, slight CRT curvature and soft green scanline bloom, authentic phosphor glow on text, high fidelity UI mock not abstract art. Chinese UI text only for labels. Real product name D1 Desk. No invented prices, dates, or commercial claims. Token field and 进入工作台 CTA must remain operable and obvious.
